episodes.title: The Crossing
episodes.summary: Howard Silk, a lowly cog in the bureaucratic machinery of a Berlin-based UN spy agency. When Howard discovers that his organization safeguards the secret of a crossing into a parallel dimension, he is thrust into a shadow world of intrigue, danger, and double cross. The only man he can trust is "Prime," Howard's near-identical counterpart from this parallel world.

episodes.title: Birds of a Feather
episodes.summary: Howard must work together with his counterpart. Baldwin comes face to face with her past. Emily, from the other side, tries to make sense of her orders.

episodes.title: The Lost Art of Diplomacy
episodes.summary: Both sides turn to diplomacy to resolve a conflict. Emily obtains a special visa. Howard interrogates a suspect.

episodes.title: Both Sides Now
episodes.summary: Both Howards deepen their investigation of the conspiracy. Quayle meets one of Howard's sources. Clare must decide what to do about Baldwin.

episodes.title: Shaking the Tree
episodes.summary: Howard discovers another side of Emily. Howard and Emily search for answers about a mysterious drop site. Aldrich and Quayle seek intel from an old friend.

episodes.title: Act Like You've Been Here Before
episodes.summary: Aldrich questions a not-too recent death in the office. Emily, Howard and Shaw follow a lead.

episodes.title: The Sincerest Form of Flattery
episodes.summary: Clare's past is revealed. Quayle suffers through his own birthday party.

episodes.title: Love the Lie
episodes.summary: The aftermath of the Indigo school discovery takes an emotional toll. Quayle grapples with his wife's new identity.

episodes.title: No Man's Land, Part One
episodes.summary: Howard attempts to thwart the Guest's plans. Howard and Emily chase Kaspar.

episodes.title: No Man's Land, Part Two
episodes.summary: A crisis at the O.I. leaves both Howards stranded.

episodes.title: Inside Out
episodes.summary: While hiding in Howard's life, Howard Prime must avoid detection at home and at the OI. Quayle and Clare struggle to adjust to their new arrangement.

episodes.title: Outside In
episodes.summary: Imprisoned on the Other Side, Howard's loyalties are tested. Emily Prime gets a promotion.

episodes.title: Something Borrowed
episodes.summary: Howard is transferred to a mysterious prison called Echo. An unexpected visit gives Emily a connection to her old life. Emily Prime and Shaw's investigation is met with resistance.

episodes.title: Point of Departure
episodes.summary: Howard Prime, Quayle and Clare must unite against a common enemy. Emily Prime turns her investigation towards her other. Yanek probes Howard's past.

episodes.title: Shadow Puppets
episodes.summary: A new revelation puts Howard Prime and Quayle in jeopardy. Life at Echo is disrupted. Clare reconnects with her past.

episodes.title: Twin Cities
episodes.summary: The origins of the Crossing are revealed.

episodes.title: No Strings Attached
episodes.summary: The fallout of the lockdown casts suspicions around the OI. Howard and Emily Prime find clues about the history of Management. Clare questions her allegiances.

episodes.title: In from the Cold
episodes.summary: Howard Prime and Emily work together to figure out Indigo's plans. Clare and Quayle consider their future. Howard must face the truth about his wife.

episodes.title: You to You
episodes.summary: Management makes a historic decision. Emily sends a warning. Quayle, Clare and Temple investigate the final Indigo cell. Howard Prime reaches out to an old contact.

episodes.title: Better Angels
episodes.summary: Mira's looming threat forges some unlikely alliances.
